text: dsh-census 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读盘点插件，通过注册 census 工具汇总当前插件加载状态、系统提示词区段与工具定义的上下文长度估算、补丁覆盖冲突及第三方插件兼容声明。调用工具可查看失败或禁用的加载项、重复提示词区段、补丁行被多层修改等发现；verbose 参数还会显示逐项清单和兼容表。它适合维护 DSH 配置、排查插件加载与上下文开销时使用。估算采用每四个字符约一个 token 的启发式方法，结果为估值。

dsh-census adds a read-only census tool to DeepSeek Harness. It summarizes plugin load states, prompt and tool context estimates, patch conflicts, and compatibility declarations. Verbose mode adds per-entry details. Token figures use a four-characters-per-token heuristic and are estimates.
想快速查看 DSH 当前加载了哪些插件，以及哪些加载失败。
怎么估算提示词区段和工具定义会占多少上下文？
I need a quick overview of plugin loading problems and duplicate prompt sections in my DSH profile.
dsh-census 的功能「插件与提示词盘点」：调用 census 工具可查看加载项状态、重复提示词区段、补丁覆盖链及插件兼容声明；设置 verbose 为 true 可展开逐项详情。

dsh-census README · dsh-census：Plugin census for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): **what is loaded, what it costs, what collides** — in one read-only tool call.

Community plugins add real capability, but nothing tells you what each one charges against your context window, whether two of them collide, or whether they still declare the harness version they were built against. Census answers those three questions deterministically, without mutating anything.

dsh-census README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-census
```

Or from a local checkout (repository-plugin style, absolute path required):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh_plugin
```

dsh-census README · The `census` tool：- **Inventory** — every loader entry (id, module specifier, enablement, fiber phase) with the same projection semantics as the official `pluginInventory/list` Remote; failed entries surface as errors, not silence.
- **Findings** — failed entries, relative specifiers (repository plugins require absolute paths), duplicate system-prompt section names in one assembly, patch rows addressed by more than one layer (patches replace a row's whole config — last write wins), and third-party plugins whose declared dsh target does not match the running harness.
- **Context suffix cost** — per-section and per-tool-schema token estimates for one assembly (fixed 4-chars-per-token heuristic), plus the share of the resolved context window when the model route advertises one.
dsh-census README · The `census` tool：Pass `verbose: true` for per-entry inventory and per-module compat tables.

dsh-census README · Scope and non-goals：- **Read-only** — census never enables, disables, patches, or repairs anything. Recovery flows already exist elsewhere (`dsh-doctor`); census deliberately does not compete with them.
- **Host-side only in 0.1** — client-UI mount-path conflicts live in browser-land and need a client half; not covered yet.
- **Heuristic cost** — the estimator mirrors the official `dsh-token-meter` fixed heuristic (4 chars/token) and inherits its documented weakness: CJK text and JSON schemas underprice badly. Treat every figure as an estimate.

dsh-census README · Model Experience：None. Census registers exactly one tool (`census`) and contributes no sections, contexts, or prompt text of its own. Its output reaches the model only when a call is made.

dsh-census README · KV Cache effect：The tool's own schema is a single short entry. Calling `census` appends one tool result to the session surface; it registers no durable messages and no runtime contexts. The report's purpose is to make **other** plugins' KV-cache cost visible: per-section and per-tool token estimates quantify exactly how much suffix each plugin's prompt contribution adds on every request.

dsh-census README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm run check   # typecheck
npm test        # unit + real-cordis integration tests
npm run build   # emit lib/

The integration test boots a real `@deepseek-ai/cordis` context, loads the official `dsh-system-prompt` and `dsh-tools` plugins, registers census, and executes it through the real tool pipeline.
